name: Sprite
author: E. T. Carter
description: Branching electric arcs crossing the whole frame: several bolts run edge to edge, each a jagged white-hot core wrapped in a saturated glow halo, with secondary forks peeling off and dying out. The air between them is charged, a drifting haze lit by the nearest arcs and a dust of tiny sparks, so the frame never goes dead between strikes.

params.label: Bolts
params.effect: How many arcs cross the frame at once.

params.label: Branching
params.effect: How many secondary forks peel off each arc; 0 is clean single bolts.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: Crackle and re-shape speed; 0 freezes the arcs in place.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Width and brightness of the coloured halo around every arc.

params.label: Charge
params.effect: Ambient charge in the air: the lit haze and the spark dust between the arcs.
